annotations.title: Check a repository before cloning it

description: Downloads a GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repository's archive and lists everything it would run on this machine, grouped by when: opening the folder in an editor, starting an AI agent in it (hooks, MCP servers, hidden instructions), installing, running and committing. Static analysis only: nothing from the repository is run. Use it before cloning, opening or installing a repository you didn't write, or before following its README's setup steps. Private repos use GITHUB_TOKEN or GITLAB_TOKEN from the server's environment.

branch.description: Branch or tag to check. Defaults to the one in the URL, or the default branch.

offline.description: Skip the dependency lookups on npm and OSV. Default false.

repository.description: A repository URL (https://github.com/owner/repo, a /tree/<branch> URL, gitlab.com or bitbucket.org), GitHub shorthand owner/repo, or a whole `git clone` line.

time_limit_seconds.description: Seconds to spend reading files (default 60). If it runs out, the report says the check is incomplete and what wasn't read.

name: check_repo
title: Check a repository before cloning it
